test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

Prachi proposed that they should meet their friends at a restaurant.

options.text: Prachi said, “We could meet their friends at a restaurant.”
Prachi said, “Let us meet their friends at a restaurant.”
Prachi said, “They should meet their friends at a restaurant.”
Prachi said, “Let them meet their friends at a restaurant.”

solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. Prachi said, “Let us meet their friends at a restaurant.”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the given directions, we have to change it into Direct Speech.
 
• The sentence express a suggestion or proposal.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be removed and comma and inverted commas will be added.
 
• In the direct speech 'proposed' will be changed into 'said.'
 
• Now, let's focus on the reported speech.
 
• 'they' will be changed into 'us.'
 
• Also, 'should' will be changed into 'let.'
 
• Finally, the result is: **Prachi said, “Let us meet their friends at a restaurant.”**
 
• ​So, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct Sentence:__* Prachi said, “Let us meet their friends at a restaurant.”*
